Job Description

You will be working on a 100% remote schedule as part of Fidelity’s dynamic working arrangement.

Current work authorization for Canada is required for all openings.

At Fidelity, we’ve been helping Canadian investors build better financial futures for over 35 years. We offer individuals and institutions a range of trusted investment portfolios and services - and we’re constantly seeking to find new and better ways to help our clients. As a privately owned company, we boldly embrace innovation in all areas as we continue to grow our business into the future.

Working with us means you’ll be part of a diverse and dedicated group of people who make a real difference for our clients and communities every day. You’ll have a wide range of opportunities to grow and develop your career in an inclusive environment where you’ll feel valued and supported to be your best - both personally and professionally.

How You’ll Make An Impact

The Director, Systems & Platform Integration will lead FCC’s capability for connecting the systems, platforms, vendors, services, and data flows that support Fidelity Clearing Canada’s business. FCC operates in a regulated clearing and brokerage environment serving introducing brokers, portfolio managers, and institutional/intermediary clients. This role owns the integration layer across FCC’s APIs, services, messages, files, data interfaces, vendor/client platform connections, workflows, reporting, operations, and enterprise services, while aligning with Fidelity Canada, FIL, and broader enterprise standards where relevant.

Integrate clients, platforms, vendors, enterprise services, APIs, messages, files, and data feeds securely and reliably.
Keep FCC’s clearing, brokerage, client, reporting, reconciliation, and operational flows auditable, monitored, recoverable, and ready for growth.
Move FCC toward reusable integration standards, stronger automation, AI enablement, operational digitization, scalable platform capabilities, and alignment with Fidelity Canada, FIL, and FCC-specific needs.
Provide senior client-facing leadership for organizations integrating with FCC, building trusted relationships with client technology and business representatives and ensuring that integration requirements, solution options, responsibilities, risks, timelines, testing, cutover readiness, and support expectations are clearly understood and effectively managed.
Own a roadmap balancing modernization, workflow automation, AI enablement, operational digitization, enterprise integration, resiliency, risk reduction, cost, and delivery trade-offs.
All direct reports have clear performance expectations, regular coaching, development plans, and succession or cross-training coverage for critical capabilities.

What We’re Looking For

University degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
7+ years of technology management and leadership experience in financial services, clearing, brokerage, wealth, custody, banking, capital markets, or another regulated transaction-processing environment.
Strong experience leading systems/platform integration, APIs, services, messaging, files, batch, data feeds, vendor connectivity, client-facing platform delivery, and modern integration platforms such as Solace, Boomi, Kafka, MuleSoft, IBM MQ/App Connect, AWS/Azure Integration Services, or similar tools.
Demonstrated technical leadership in integration architecture, solution design, design reviews, non-functional requirements, production readiness, and technical risk decisions.
Demonstrated experience in a client-facing leadership role, working directly with external clients and senior stakeholders
Experience leading teams of architects, analysts, technical leads, integration specialists, etc.,

The Skill Set You Bring

Experience using AI-assisted development, automation, analytics insight, developer productivity tooling, and enterprise integration capabilities is an asset
Experience governing integration standards for service contracts, data mappings, API design, event flows, file exchanges, error handling, monitoring, logging, auditability, and support handoff.
Strong understanding of Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, cloud-enabled architecture, production reliability, observability, incident/problem/change
Technically credible and engineering-first - understands APIs, services, messages, files, event streaming, iPaaS, ESB, data flows, system dependencies, production support, architecture, standards, integration tools such as Solace, Boomi, Kafka, MuleSoft or similar platforms, automation, developer productivity, and technical risk.
Understands clearing, brokerage, reporting, reconciliation, regulatory, service quality, and operational impacts.
Architecturally minded, modernization oriented, and operationally disciplined - drives reusable standards, scalable integration capability, monitoring, controls, recoverability, cybersecurity, auditability, resilience, and production stability.
Strong client-facing, relationship-management, presentation, and communication skills, with the credibility to lead technical discussions, explain trade-offs, resolve issues, and build confidence with clients, partners, and senior executives.
Enterprise-aligned portfolio integrator - connects FCC priorities with Fidelity Canada, FIL, enterprise technology direction, modernization, AI enablement, operational digitization, and BAU stability.

jobs.title: Director, Investment & Digital Enablement
jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What You'll Be Doing

As a Director, Investment & Digital Enablement, you will be a strategic voice on the Savings, Investments and Advice team. You will support defining the business intent and outcomes, author business cases, groom roadmaps and initiative-level direction for some of our most complex, highest-impact client journeys, working 1–3 quarters ahead to ensure squads always have a business-justified pipeline to execute against. You will regularly extend your expertise across multiple squads, partnering and advising stakeholders and Sr. Executives, while mentoring emerging talent across the team.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You’ll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you’ll spend 1-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote.

How You'll Succeed

Own the business case and roadmap for high-impact initiatives — Lead the development of the squad-level roadmap, business cases and benefit forecasts for highly visible initiatives in the Saving, Investments & Advice domain, ensuring every initiative entering the backlog is grounded in a clear, quantifiable business rationale.
Lead discovery and business direction — Author and facilitate discovery with your Product Owner & stakeholders, establishing the business direction, journey context and initiative framing that sets the direction for requirements and overall squad success.
Author epics that set squads up to win — Defining business objectives, success metrics and scope before a single story is written. Hold the quality bar for Epics across the team.
Be the senior business voice with stakeholders — Act as the interface between your squads and senior business stakeholders, translating progress into compelling business narratives and representing the squad wherever investment and prioritization decisions are made.
Own benefit realization — Define KPIs and success metrics at the outset of every initiative, and partner with measurement and analytics teams post-launch to track performance against the original business case.
Extend your expertise across squads — Provide advisory support to multiple squads, bringing consistency and best practice to business execution planning throughout.
Mentor and elevate team talent — Coach junior and intermediate members of the Investment & Digital Enablement team and contribute directly to team standards, tools and ways of working.

Who You Are

You can demonstrate experience. 10+ years of experience in leading large, cross-functional, complex initiatives, business analysis, client/product strategy, or a closely related discipline, ideally within financial services or another regulated environment. You have a proven track record of owning Epics, business cases, or equivalent initiative-level artifacts, and translating them into roadmaps that Product Owners and squads can execute against.
You can demonstrate knowledge. You bring working knowledge of agile delivery — Jira, Epics and Stories, story-writing standards and INVEST principles — and apply it fluently across a multi-squad environment.
You are a strategic storyteller and influencer. You are able to distill complex, ambiguous business problems into a clear narrative and business case that earns buy-in from Product Owners, technology partners and senior executives alike.
You are a systems thinker with commercial instinct. You connect client needs, business objectives and platform capability, and know how to sequence work so today's results sets up tomorrow's opportunity.
You are a credible communicator. You are able to effectively communicate with senior business stakeholders, capable of building and defending a business case at the executive level.
You are comfortable with ambiguity. You can hold a long view of the roadmap 1–3 quarters ahead, while still bringing the discipline to translate strategy into a well-scoped, buildable Epic.
You are a trusted advisor. You build credibility through the quality of your thinking and the consistency of your judgment rather than a reporting line, and you use that credibility to guide Product Owners and shape team standards. You have experience mentoring or informally guiding colleagues. This role does not carry formal people-management accountability, but team-level mentorship is core to the mandate.
You live your values. You bring high standards, genuine care to your relationships, and want to grow with an employer that shares your values and brings out your best.

What CIBC Offers

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program*, defined benefit pension plan*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.
Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.
We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.
Subject to plan and program terms and conditions

jobs.title: Managing Director, Digital Finance
jobs.description:
Venture outside the ordinary - TMX Careers

The TMX group of companies includes leading global exchanges such as the Toronto Stock Exchange, Montreal Exchange, and numerous innovative organizations enhancing capital markets. United as a global team, we’re connecting cross-functionally, traversing industries and geographies, moving opportunity into action, advancing global economic growth, and propelling progress. Through a rich exchange of ideas, meaningful collaboration, and a nimble operating model, we're powering some of the nation's most critical systems, fueling capital formation and innovation, bringing increased opportunity to business visionaries, product ingenuity to consumers, and career exploration to our team.

Ready to be part of the action?

The Managing Director, Digital Finance
serves as the senior finance leader accountable for leading the strategic transformation of Finance operations across systems, data, reporting, business processes, and artificial intelligence. In this business leadership capacity, you will establish priorities, set governance standards, and ensure sustained adoption and measurable value creation. Operating as the primary business counterpart to Technology and working in close partnership with the Chief Financial Officer and senior leadership, you will oversee the strategic roadmap to replace manual, fragmented workflows with a trusted, single source of financial data and insight that accelerates enterprise decision-making and supports global growth.

Reports to:
Chief Strategy and Innovation Officer

Job Location:
Hybrid (2–3 days/week in office) – based in Toronto, ON.

Key Accountabilities

Finance Transformation & Portfolio Delivery

Own and champion the multi-year Digital Finance roadmap and unified backlog across the CFO organization, prioritizing initiatives by business value, control requirements, readiness, effort, and operational cost in close collaboration with Technology.
Sponsor and drive end-to-end process redesign across record-to-report, plan-to-perform, procure-to-pay, and order-to-cash workflows to modernize core operations.
Establish robust business cases for all digital initiatives, tracking adoption metrics, cycle-time reductions, redeployed capacity, and internal control enhancements.
Authorize the decommissioning of legacy reports, spreadsheets, and manual steps following the rigorous validation of modern digital replacements.

Finance Systems & Core Architecture

Act as the accountable Finance business owner for Workday Financials and Workday Adaptive Planning in collaboration with Controllership and FP&A process owners, establishing high standards for clean data capture, straight-through processing, chart-of-accounts governance, and audit-ready planning workflows.
Ensure Workday configurations align with enterprise best practices, spearheading the design and ongoing governance of the Foundation Data Model (FDM) to support scalable accounting, reporting, and analytics requirements.
Partner with Technology, external implementation specialists, and Workday to conduct recurring architecture reviews and remediate configuration gaps.
Oversee and approve the business roadmap for the broader finance application ecosystem (close management, consolidations, billing, accounts payable, expense management, treasury, and tax), actively identifying rationalization opportunities.
Align application release schedules with the financial close calendar, collaborating with Technology, Risk, and Internal Audit to enforce rigorous segregation of duties, access controls, and Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR).

Finance Data, BI & Analytics

Direct the team responsible for designing, building, and operating finance data models, data pipelines, and certified financial data products on Snowflake, establishing a single source of truth across all global entities.
Establish robust semantic layer governance, ensuring every certified data product possesses an assigned Finance owner, approved definitions, and ongoing reconciliation to general ledger accounting outputs.
Oversee Finance’s enterprise Business Intelligence (BI) capabilities and visualization standards, transitioning teams from static reporting to dynamic, interactive dashboards and executive decision environments utilizing tools such as Amazon QuickSight and native cloud analytics capabilities.
Accelerate data-driven insights across Finance by collaborating with Finance Business Partners and operational data teams to integrate financial and operational drivers, including trading, clearing, listings, and market data subscriptions.

Applied AI & Intelligent Automation

Identify, prioritize, and oversee the rollout of high-impact finance AI use cases—such as variance analysis, exception triage, predictive forecasting, narrative document synthesis, and anomaly detection—ensuring each deployment maintains clear quality thresholds, human-in-the-loop oversight, and independent model validation.
Drive end-to-end automation of data collation, reconciliation, and distribution throughout the reporting cycle while safeguarding professional financial judgment and formal authorization checkpoints.

Market Innovation & Continuous Improvement

Monitor evolving capabilities across Workday, Snowflake, business intelligence ecosystems, and emerging financial technologies, assessing business viability and integrating high-value opportunities into the strategic roadmap.
Provide strategic advisory to the Finance Senior Leadership Team on emerging technology trends, fostering shared ownership of digital adoption.

People Leadership & Change Enablement

Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary team spanning finance systems, data engineering, business intelligence, and advanced analytics, establishing clear strategic direction while scaling functional capacity.
Drive enterprise change management, communication, and training programs to embed digital literacy and analytical curiosity across the broader finance organization.
Manage the Digital Finance operational budget, serving as the business partner to Technology and Procurement for vendor selection and delivery partner management.

Must Have(s)

12+ years of progressive finance experience with comprehensive knowledge of core accounting and financial processes, coupled with advanced financial analysis capabilities.
Professional accounting or financial credential (CPA preferred; MBA or CFA will also be considered).
Demonstrated success serving as the business lead for major finance transformations (e.g., enterprise ERP implementations, EPM/planning platforms, or enterprise data and reporting overhauls) from conception through operational adoption and value realization.
Proven leadership experience guiding data, BI, or analytics personnel, underpinned by sufficient technical literacy in data modeling, SQL, cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake), and modern BI suites to establish standards and guide technical execution.
Deep knowledge of financial governance frameworks, internal controls, and ICFR requirements within large-scale system and process transformation environments.
Demonstrated track record managing multi-year business cases, departmental budgets, third-party software vendors, and systems integration partners.
Proven leadership acumen in ambiguous, matrixed environments with strong cross-functional stakeholder management and executive presentation skills.

Nice to Have(s)

Experience with Workday Financials and Workday Adaptive Planning, including Foundation Data Model (FDM) architecture and data integration with Snowflake.
Direct technical experience with data querying and scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python).
Practical experience deploying artificial intelligence or machine learning solutions within corporate finance environments, including model validation and risk management frameworks.
Industry experience within capital markets, financial services, financial technology, or software organizations.
Leadership background within multi-entity, multi-currency, and multinational operating structures.
Experience building, structuring, and scaling a digital or transformation function from early-stage maturity.

The recruiting efforts for this role are intended to fill a vacant position.

In the market for…

Excitement
- Explore emerging technology and innovation, as well as ventures and digital finance that shape the future of global markets! Experience the movement of the market while grounded in the stability of close to 200 years of success.

Connection
- With site hubs in some of the world’s most multicultural cities, we leverage our size and structure to create rich connections and belonging while experiencing powerful global impact through our work.

Impact
- More than a platform, we use our talents to power mission-critical systems that drive global economic advancement, innovation, and growth. As well, our employee-led Team Impact spreads social good via our giving strategy.

Wellness
- From empathetic leadership to a culture of flexibility and balance, we believe wellness at work creates the maximum yield and a stronger “we”. Plus, with a cloud-first and hybrid workstyle, as well as generous time-off and leaves, we support a life well lived!

Growth
- From a growth mindset in our work, to expansion in our business, TMX is home to action-takers energized by the achievement of ambitious growth.

Ready to enrich your career with impactful work, leaders who truly care, and the flexibility and programs to help you thrive as part of #TeamTMX ? Apply now.

jobs.description:
We Are Banking At Another Level.

Choosing BDC as your employer
means working in a healthy, inclusive, and skilled workplace that puts forward the best conditions to bring together unique teams where employees are empowered to act. It also means being at the centre of ambitious economic and financial projects to see further and to do things differently, to fuel the success of Canadian entrepreneurs.

Choosing BDC As Your Employer Also Means

Flexible and competitive benefits, including an Employee Savings and Investment Plan where BDC matches part of your voluntary contributions, a Defined Benefit Pension Plan, a $750 wellness and health care spending account, to name a few
In addition to paid vacation each year, five personal days, sick days as necessary, and our offices are closed from December 25 to January 1
A hybrid work model that truly balances work and personal life
Opportunities for learning, training and development, and much more...

Explore the BDC Way in our Culture Book

Position Overview

BDC Mission AI helps small and medium-sized businesses identify their needs, matches them with Canadian AI solutions, and tests these tools in real-world business settings. To do this, we’re building a self-sufficient and agile AI platform, moving at a startup’s pace.

As Director of Technology, you are a builder who codes. You design and operate the Mission AI platform, lead a small team that delivers quickly, and contribute your AI expertise to technology and investment decisions. You make technical decisions within the authorized framework, in collaboration with business leaders—who define requirements and value criteria—and with the validation and investment teams.

CHALLENGES TO BE MET

AI Architecture and Platform
Define the architecture and technology roadmap for the AI platform, including decisions on whether to build, buy, or partner.
Deliver platform milestones, from the diagnostic MVP to its phased rollout to Canadian SMEs.
Establish AI system evaluation, human oversight, and tracking of operating costs.
Development and Team Leadership
Recruit, lead, and develop the AI development team; establish best practices for delivery, quality, and AI-assisted development.
Internal and External Technology
Develop the team’s internal tools: radar, pilot tracking, and metrics dashboards.
Provide the team with AI agents and automations that increase their autonomy and productivity; make Mission AI a model for AI-driven work.
Manage technology vendors and platform operations: availability, access, security, and disaster recovery.
Integrate BDC systems only when necessary, using lightweight connections.
Obtain BDC’s security and data protection approvals without slowing down delivery.
Conduct technical due diligence on investments: architecture, code quality, AI defensibility, data, security, intellectual property, costs, and scalability.
Evaluate the security and integrability of solutions with the relevant teams prior to approval.
Metrics and Data
Measure usage and productivity gains at 3, 6, and 12 months.
Conduct assessments and create a dynamic map of SMB needs.

Priorities for the First 90 Days

Define the architecture, data model, security requirements, and delivery plan.
Deliver the diagnostic MVP and test it with pilot SMEs.
Hire the first AI developers and establish development and evaluation practices.

What Success Looks Like (12–18 Months)

Platform milestones achieved, from the MVP to nationwide rollout.
Quality of AI recommendations and responses, reliability, cost per diagnosis.
Technical deliverables completed on schedule; team autonomy.

What We’re Looking For

10 or more years in software development
At least 7 years in technical leadership as well
Someone who still codes on a daily basis
Active developer: proficiency in a modern programming language and the ability to deploy to production independently.
Advanced AI expertise: products in production based on large language models (agents, RAG, evaluations, costs, and performance).
Knowledge of the model ecosystem (commercial, open-source, and Canadian) and the ability to select the right model for the use case.
Proficiency in cloud architecture, APIs, data pipelines, and application security.
Ability to explain a technical risk to a business stakeholder and to critically evaluate a startup or vendor.

Assets

Experience as a CTO or founding engineer at a startup or scale-up: strongly preferred.
Technical due diligence for investments (funds, venture studios, acquisitions).
Visible contributions: open-source projects, technical publications, launched AI products.
Knowledge of security requirements in regulated environments (financial institutions or government).

What Will Make The Difference

Pragmatic builder: prototypes in days, deploys to production in weeks.
Stays at the cutting edge of AI and applies it practically, without chasing every trend.
Keeps the user in focus: an SME owner with no IT staff or spare time.
Builds a platform where AI is the driving force, not an add-on, and empowers the entire team to work differently.

Why join BDC?

Combine the scale and mission of a national development bank with the autonomy of a startup. You’ll contribute to one of BDC’s most ambitious initiatives and shape the adoption of AI by Canadian SMEs.

Proudly one of Canada’s Top 100 Employers
and one of Canada’s Best Diversity Employers
, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive and accessible environment where all employees can thrive and feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work. Overview

Director, Digital & Information Management is a leadership role responsible for developing and implementing the digital strategy and information management framework for one of our major new build projects. The role is responsible for developing and implementing the digital strategy and information management framework for this project. The Director reports functionally to the Vice-President, Digital Solutions and operationally to the Project Director.

This Director ensures that all project data, documentation, and digital systems are integrated, secure, and aligned with company standards, regulatory requirements, industry standards, and project objectives. The position drives digital transformation to enable efficient collaboration, lifecycle data management, and regulatory compliance across engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning phases.

Key responsibilities include leading project teams, developing work execution plans, recruiting and assigning team members, managing project deliverables, organizational structure, budget, schedule, risk management, and overseeing people forecasting and levelling for the project.

Your role

Lead the development and execution of the Digital and Information Management strategy for a large-scale nuclear new build project.
Align digital initiatives with project objectives, corporate standards, regulatory requirements, and long-term asset lifecycle management.
Champion digital transformation through BIM, digital twins, data analytics, advanced collaboration platforms, and emerging technologies.
Establish and govern enterprise-wide information management frameworks, including data governance, metadata standards, and document control processes.
Ensure compliance with nuclear industry regulations, cybersecurity standards, and industry best practices such as ISO 19650 and IEC 62645.
Implement and manage integrated digital systems, including BIM, EDMS, project controls, scheduling, cost management, ERP, and asset information platforms.
Lead the deployment of Common Data Environments (CDE) and Advanced Work Packaging (AWP) solutions across EPCM partners, suppliers, and stakeholders.
Oversee project-wide BIM execution, ensuring cross-disciplinary integration, interoperability, data quality, and a single source of truth for project information.
Establish robust cybersecurity, digital safety, training, and corrective action programs to protect critical systems and ensure regulatory compliance.
Monitor digital performance, drive stakeholder adoption, report on system effectiveness and data integrity, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement and cost optimization.

About You

Minimum 10 years of leadership experience in digital transformation, information management, or IT management within large infrastructure, engineering, energy, or industrial projects.
Strong expertise with BIM, Common Data Environments (CDE), Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS), and project controls platforms.
Experience with integrated 3D engineering design technologies such as Hexagon SmartPlant/Smart 3D, AVEVA, or comparable plant design systems.
Knowledge of nuclear new build projects, reactor design, construction execution, and nuclear industry operating practices is preferred.
Proven ability to lead teams, manage direct reports, and support project delivery organizations through complex digital initiatives.
Solid understanding of Advanced Work Packaging (AWP), engineering, procurement, and construction workflows within large capital projects.
Familiarity with ISO 19650 information management standards, cybersecurity frameworks, and nuclear regulatory compliance requirements.
Strong commitment to nuclear safety culture, industrial safety programs, quality assurance standards, and continuous regulatory compliance.
Demonstrated leadership, stakeholder engagement, communication, customer relationship, and organizational management skills with the ability to drive change.
Proven ability to exercise sound judgment, accountability, teamwork, delegation, problem-solving, and decision-making while performing effectively in high-pressure environments.

Own all deal types end-to-end ranging from standard structures to complex, unique, and customer-specific arrangements.

Title And Summary

Director, Fraud Attack Response & Insights - Americas

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.

Overview

The Fraud Attack Response & Insights team is Mastercard’s integrated fraud attack response, intelligence, and card security control functions, overseeing real-time incident response, fraud insights generation, and card/application security standards.

The Director, Fraud Attack Response & Insights/Americas role is responsible for response orchestration and insights generation across fraud attacks impacting Mastercard customers in Canada, US and Latin America.

The role is focused on fraud on account opening, payment cards and account-to-account transactions. This is a role focused on securing the transactions Mastercard enables and the stakeholders in those transactions (e.g., issuers, acquirers, merchants). This is not a corporate or information security function.

Role

Lead participation in high-impact fraud TRTs (as commander or delegate)
Drive post-incident retrospectives and systemic remediation recommendations
Translate incident learnings into network-level controls, standards, or enhancements for products in the Security Solutions organization
Liaison between the fraud attack risk registry management and fraud intelligence teams
Manage a small team of regional experts

All About You

Deep fraud operations expertise
Payment and payment fraud experience , with advanced experience in payment fraud analytics, fraud intelligence, network or product security and cross-functional governance
Progressive leadership positions in payment fraud at a regional or global level
Strategic and continuous learner mindset
Proven ability to make decisions under uncertainty
Proven experience in managing high-performance teams across time zones and nurturing talent

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
